units: <cite ref="Berakhot 43b:5">Ber. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>כל אחד ואחד יִפָּה לו וכ׳</he> to each man the Lord made his trade appear nice.
Y. Succ. V, end, 55ᵈ (play on be-ĕmunatham I Chron. IX, 22) באומנותם through their skill; a. fr.— the workmanship (or its equivalent) to be furnished the (Roman) government.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 6:8:10">Y. Dem. VI, end, 26ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:4">Tosef. Dem. VI, 4</cite>; cmp. <cite ref="A00825"><he>אוֹצָר</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>אוּמָנִיּוֹת</he>.
Num. R. s. 15 קורא א׳ invited people by trades (each day another trade); Tanḥ. B’haăl., 3 קורא בכל יום א׳.—Trnsf. arts, devices.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 47">Ex. R. s. 47</cite>, end <he>כל הצדיקים באו בא׳</he> all the righteous (in their pleas and prayers) came with devices before the Lord (as Abraham prayed in behalf of fifty, forty &c.).
